hooks.command: CMD=$(jq -r ".tool_input.command // \"\""); printf "%s" "$CMD" | grep -qE "gh pr merge" && printf "%s" "$CMD" | grep -qE "branch -D|branch -d|push origin --delete|--delete-branch" && printf "%s" '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"Never chain a branch delete onto a merge. gh pr merge fails on a bad flag or a state/ conflict and the chained delete still runs, closing the unmerged PR (cost PRs 65, 80, 92). Verify gh pr view N --json state prints MERGED as its own step first."}}'; exit 0

CMD=$(jq -r ".tool_input.command // \"\""); printf "%s" "$CMD" | grep -qE "^[[:space:]]*git add" && printf "%s" "$CMD" | grep -q "state/" && printf "%s" '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"ask","permissionDecisionReason":"state/ is owned by the paper-engine Action; committing local writes caused the PR 92 conflict. Confirm ONLY if deliberately opening or repairing a book. Otherwise discard: git checkout -- state/"}}'; exit 0

CMD=$(jq -r ".tool_input.command // \"\""); case "$CMD" in *"git commit"*) D="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-/Users/dzheng/tradefabe}"; git -C "$D" rev-parse --git-dir >/dev/null 2>&1 || D="/Users/dzheng/tradefabe"; EMAIL=$(git -C "$D" config --local user.email 2>/dev/null); if [ "$EMAIL" != "76966554+dzheng1328@users.noreply.github.com" ]; then printf %s '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"Local git user.email is not the noreply alias -- commits would be misattributed (cost PR #189 a 3rd co-author identity). Run: git config --local user.email 76966554+dzheng1328@users.noreply.github.com, then retry."}}'; exit 0; fi; if printf %s "$CMD" | grep -qiE "co-authored-by:.*(claude|anthropic)"; then printf %s '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"Never add a Co-Authored-By trailer for Claude/Anthropic here -- every tradefabe commit shows Dave alone as author, intentionally. The Generated-with-Claude-Code disclosure LINE is fine; the trailer is not."}}'; exit 0; fi;; esac; exit 0

CMD=$(jq -r ".tool_input.command // \"\""); if printf %s "$CMD" | grep -qE "gh pr merge"; then PR=$(printf %s "$CMD" | grep -oE "gh pr merge [0-9]+" | grep -oE "[0-9]+"); if [ -n "$PR" ]; then TOUCHED=$(gh pr diff "$PR" --name-only 2>/dev/null | grep -E "^(STRATEGIES\.md|graveyard\.csv)$"); if [ -n "$TOUCHED" ]; then printf %s '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"ask","permissionDecisionReason":"This PR touches STRATEGIES.md/graveyard.csv -- has the doctrine-auditor subagent reviewed it? Its 5 checks (pre-registration ordering, matched null, declared deviations, multiple-testing hygiene, reproducibility) catch exactly the failure class DOCTRINE.md exists to prevent. Confirm only if it already ran, or you are deliberately skipping it."}}'; exit 0; fi; fi; fi; exit 0

F=$(jq -r ".tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath // \"\""); case "$F" in *src/tradefabe/*.py) D="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-/Users/dzheng/tradefabe}"; OUT=$("$D/.venv/bin/pytest" "$D/tests" -q -x 2>&1 | sed "s/\x1b\[[0-9;]*m//g" | tail -3); printf "%s" "$OUT" | grep -q "failed\|error" && printf '{"systemMessage":"engine edit broke the suite: %s"}' "$(printf "%s" "$OUT" | tr -d '"' | tr "\n" " " | cut -c1-200)";; esac; exit 0
hooks.statusMessage: running the suite after an engine edit
